draft.subject: order tracking spreadsheets
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

A different angle. Your job ads ask for advanced Excel to maintain order tracking spreadsheets. Your competitor Bramley Haulage already automates its order entry and quotes same-day.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Would a shorter path from order to dispatch be useful?

evidence.text: Owen Carr, Operations Director at Pennine Fasteners: we still re-key every emailed order into our system by hand. Three people, all day, every day.
Advanced Excel skills required; you will maintain our order tracking spreadsheets.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
